verdict.rationale: Anrok exposes a broad, well-documented API surface (customers, transactions, certificates, tax IDs, address resolution, filings, product mappings) that covers most core tax-calculation and compliance workflows, and explicitly markets 'Headless Tax' as a way to run everything through APIs instead of the UI. However, some UI-highlighted features (e.g. dashboard exposure map, registration threshold tracker, automatic registration completion, filing/payment workflows) are not clearly confirmed as API-accessible, and no independent verification (e.g. discoverable OpenAPI spec) was found—probe attempts for openapi.json and llms.txt returned 404s. Missing for 10: confirmed API parity for registration/filing/dashboard analytics features, and independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
